title: 第十三章逃离小月宗第二十一章收获
slug: 凡人修仙我能变废为宝
lines: 之前江离虽有了脱离小月宗的想法，态度其实并不坚定。
主要是像炼丹房这种可以收集废丹的地方，可不是哪里都有。
在经历洛仙子一事之后，江离才彻底坚定了脱离小月宗的想法了。
他在小月宗的身份不过是一名杂役弟子，对于那些仙人老爷而言，和一条杂狗没有什么区别。
虽然是因为小月宗，他才获得了修仙功法，但他对小月宗可从来都没有什么忠诚度可言。
留在小月宗，与小月宗一同抵挡外敌，这一想法对江离而言只是一个好笑的笑话。
江离和宋展对视一眼，两人几乎同时有了动作，快步走去了自己的房间。
返回房间，自然是要收拾东西准备跑路。
丹药，肯定是要带上的。
木盒和黄庭经以及另外两门术法，自然也要带。
除了这些，其余杂物，全是累赘。
将这些东西收拾好，再次走出房门，正巧宋展也带着一个包裹从房间内走出。
不需言语，双方都看出了对方有想要跑路的打算。
“江离师弟，等会儿若是开战，你我二人只能各安天命，是生是死全看运气。若是有缘，将来再见。”
看到江离也有想要跑路的打算，宋展说道。
江离点点头，明白了宋展的真实意思。
无非就是在说一会儿要是打起来，让江离别跟着他，当个累赘。
江离对这番话倒也没有觉得舒服的地方。
大难临头各自飞。
宋展这么做，也无可厚非。
没多时，一名老者从小月宗深处飞了出来，一股威压瞬间覆盖了整个小月宗。
此人，正是小月宗唯一的一名金丹修士白云禾。
“这位道友是不是误会了？我们小月宗一直安分守己，怎敢盗窃你们台海宗的功法。”
白云禾说道。
法阵外的台海宗修士却对这股威压视若无睹，问道：“你便是小月宗唯一的一名金丹期修士白云禾？”
白云禾点点头：“正是老夫。”
台海宗修士道：“既然如此，事情便简单了。既然你说是误会，便打开你们的护宗法阵，让我们进去查验。若真是误会，自然会还你们小月宗一个清白。”
白云禾面色一下子阴沉了下来。
打开护宗法阵让对方进入，那岂不是亲自把自己放在了案板上？
自己好歹是堂堂金丹期修士，这台海宗的修士竟一点面子也不给。
不由道：“台海宗如此咄咄逼人，恕老夫难以从命。”
“很好。”
台海宗修士眼中杀意闪烁：“既然如此，事情也好办了。”
“台海宗弟子听令！攻入小月宗，将小月宗内所有人全部缉拿。若有反抗，一律斩杀！”
白云禾也知事情没有了回转的余地。
当即喝道：“莫要欺负我们小月宗无人！小月宗弟子听令，御敌！”
双方令下，大战一触即发。
台海宗修士显然有备而来。
一声令下，战船中便飞出二十来名修士。
手中拿出相同的法宝，在狂暴的灵力灌输下，这些法宝一同飞出，狠狠的轰击在小月宗护宗法阵的光盾上。
轰！
轰！
轰！
仅是四五下，护宗法阵的光盾便出现了裂纹。

Although Jiang Li had the idea of ​​leaving Xiaoyue Sect before, his attitude was not firm.
Mainly places like alchemy rooms where waste pills can be collected are not available everywhere.
After experiencing the incident with Fairy Luo, Jiang Li finally firmly decided to leave Xiaoyue Sect.
His status in Xiaoyue Sect is just that of a handyman disciple. To those immortal masters, he is no different from a miscellaneous dog.
Although it was because of Xiao Yue Zong that he obtained the immortality cultivation technique, he had never been loyal to Xiao Yue Zong.
The idea of ​​staying in Xiaoyue Sect and resisting foreign enemies together with Xiaoyue Sect was just a funny joke to Jiang Li.
Jiang Li and Song Zhan looked at each other, and they moved almost at the same time, walking quickly to their rooms.
When I returned to my room, I naturally had to pack my things and prepare to run away.
You must bring the elixir with you.
Naturally, the wooden box, Huang Ting Sutra and the other two techniques must be brought.
Apart from these, all other debris is just a burden.
After packing these things, he walked out of the room again. It happened that Song Zhan also walked out of the room with a package.
Without words, both parties could see that the other party was planning to run away.
"Junior Brother Jiang Li, if a war breaks out later, you and I will have to make our own destiny. Whether we live or die depends on luck. If we are destined, we will meet again in the future."
Seeing that Jiang Li also had plans to run away, Song Zhan said.
Jiang Li nodded and understood what Song Zhan really meant.
It was nothing more than saying that if there was a fight later, Jiang Libie would follow him and be a burden.
Jiang Li didn't feel comfortable with these words.
When disaster strikes, we all fly away.
There is nothing wrong with Song Zhan doing this.
Not long after, an old man flew out from the depths of Xiaoyue Sect, and a pressure instantly covered the entire Xiaoyue Sect.
This person is none other than Bai Yunhe, the only golden elixir monk in Xiaoyue Sect.
"Has this fellow Taoist misunderstood? Our Xiaoyue Sect has always kept to itself. How dare we steal your Taihai Sect's skills?"
Bai Yunhe said.
The Taihai Sect monk outside the magic circle turned a blind eye to this pressure and asked: "Are you Bai Yunhe, the only Jindan stage monk of Xiaoyue Sect?"
Bai Yunhe nodded: "It's me."
The Taihai Sect monk said: "In this case, the matter is simple. Since you said it was a misunderstanding, open your sect-protecting array and let us go in for inspection. If it is really a misunderstanding, we will naturally restore your Xiaoyue Sect's innocence."
Bai Yunhe's expression suddenly darkened.
If you open the ancestral protection circle and let the other party enter, wouldn't that mean you are putting yourself on the chopping board?
After all, he is a dignified Jindan monk, but this monk from Taiwan Haizong didn't give him any face.
He couldn't help but say: "Taihai Sect is so aggressive, I'm sorry I can't obey his orders."
"Very good."
The Taihai Sect monk's eyes flashed with murderous intent: "In that case, things will be easier to handle."
"Taihai Sect disciples listen to the order! Attack Xiaoyue Sect and arrest everyone in Xiaoyue Sect. If there is resistance, they will be killed!"
Bai Yunhe also knew that there was no room for turning things around.
Immediately shouted: "Don't bully our Xiaoyue Sect's no one! Xiaoyue Sect's disciples obey orders and defend against the enemy!"
Under the orders of both sides, the war is about to break out.
The Taihai Sect monks were obviously well prepared.
With an order, about twenty monks flew out of the warship.
He took out the same magic weapons in his hands. Infused with violent spiritual power, these magic weapons flew out together and violently bombarded the light shield of Xiaoyue Sect's protective formation.
boom!
boom!
boom!
In just four or five blows, cracks appeared in the light shield of the protective sect formation.
